title: Pura Vida | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Community Pool And Gulf Views- Pura Vida By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Pura Vida by Royal Destinations Location: WaterSound Beach Address: 82 South Founders Lane Details: Escape to Pura Vida, a stunning home and carriage house nestled behind the gates of the exclusive WaterSound Community just three homes from the beach! Designed for large families or groups, this elegant retreat offers 3,475 square feet of coastal sophistication and comfort. Inside, you’ll find hardwood floors throughout, an open, airy layout, and a chef’s kitchen equipped with premium Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, plus a wine cooler and ice maker that are perfect for entertaining. Wake up to breathtaking Gulf views from the second and third floors, or unwind after a day at the beach on one of the home’s inviting porches. With its separate carriage house, spacious design, and prime location, Pura Vida is your perfect 30A getaway for relaxation, luxury, and unforgettable memories. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 20 Yards -Parking Spaces: 2 in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table for 6, Bar Seating for 5, Outside Seating for 8 -Coffee Maker Available -(4) Adult Bikes -Gas Grill -Third Floor Tower -Gulf Views -Fireplace WaterSound Community Highlights: -Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach -(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate) -Kayak Rentals -Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach -A short walk to the HUB *Please Note: Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 5 Beds / 5.5 Baths Main House: 4 Beds / 4.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room -Half Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: Twin/Full Bunk with Private Bath (Shower) Third Floor (Tower): -Additional Bedding: Full Futon Carriage House: 1 Bed / 1 Bath -Full Kitchen / Living Room / Laundry -Bedroom 5: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Additional Bedding: Queen Futon Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
